transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the routine morning logistics huddle so we can finalize today's water-dispatch order. We have 5,400 gallons of potable water available and two tanker loads to plan — each load can carry up to 2,700 gallons. Our four receiving sites are North Post, the clinic, the maintenance workshop, and Observation Site East, with a standard request of 1,200 gallons per site. Before I publish the final dispatch order, I need to hear from each of you on any same-day changes affecting your lanes. Water point, medical, motor transport, and engineering — please report in turn.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, the water point has a same-day update: the purification unit can release the first tanker load at 0700 and the second load at exactly 1200. The second-release time is in the water-point log but hasn't been copied into the distribution worksheet yet, so I want to make sure it's captured here before the order is published.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, medical has a same-day update. I confirmed this morning that the clinic requires exactly 1,500 gallons today, including a 300-gallon increase for a scheduled sterilization cycle. This medical request amendment has not yet reached the S-4 desk, so I want to make sure it's captured here before the final dispatch order is published.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, motor transport has a same-day update. The tanker has a mandatory inspection scheduled from 0645 to 0730, so the first load cannot dispatch until exactly 0730. The inspection slot is posted on the transportation board but hasn't been reflected on the draft water order yet, so I want to make sure it's captured before the final dispatch order is published.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Ma'am, engineering has a same-day update. I confirmed that the access road to the maintenance workshop is closed from 0900 to 1200. The second-load tanker will need to use the east service road detour, which adds 20 minutes of travel time, meaning the workshop can be reached at exactly 1250 on the second load. This closure notice has not yet been added to the route overlay, so I want to make sure it's captured here before the final dispatch order is published.
